definition: For each of the 390 price-ceiling events, each leg's residency-maker reachable window = contiguous tape intervals where best_ask<=maker_floor, unioned with the seller-aggressed print instant at<=maker_floor. OVERLAP = the two legs' reachable sets intersect in time (both rests fillable simultaneously). DISJOINT = no intersection (sequential-only).
reachability_note: Reachability = best_ask<=maker_floor (an offer at or below our resting maker bid is fillable). It does NOT re-impose the pricer's 10s signing dwell or 5-lot capacity gate: maker_floor is already capacity-qualified upstream (qualifying_ask_floor had >=5 cap, or the seller-aggressed print carried real size); those are signing gates, not physical fill conditions.

disjoint_ordering.note: Which leg reaches its maker floor first in the sequential (disjoint) events.

headline: Of 390 price-ceiling events, only 31 are simultaneously lockable (overlapping reachable windows); 359 are sequential-only. The executable simultaneous ceiling is ~31/804 = 3.9% of games; at par (<=97) only 10.
